layer1.name: Transistor.fm
layer1.one_liner: Podcast hosting and analytics for people who publish more than one show.
layer1.description: Hosting with unlimited shows per account, private podcasts and distribution analytics, sold as a subscription. Two founders, entering a category with entrenched incumbents.
layer1.outcome_note: Went from $33 in monthly revenue at launch to over $1M ARR without outside investment. Later reported serving thousands of paying accounts.

sources.note: Co-founder's page on the company site
Interview covering the path to $1M ARR
